clips.title: The story
paras: Piercing the Veil is an introductory warlock trial given by Venya Marthand in Deathknell. It tests a freshly risen warlock's resolve by directing them to collect skulls from nearby mindless skeletons. Completing the task earns the novice the knowledge required to summon and bind an imp minion.

Newly awakened Forsaken warlocks begin their journey in Deathknell under the instruction of Venya Marthand. She teaches that true strength lies not in raw brute force, but in knowledge and the precise mastery of chaotic powers. To prove they possess the focus and capability required to pierce the veil between worlds and subjugate nether beings, novices are dispatched to harvest the skulls of restless Rattlecage Skeletons roaming near Deathknell's abandoned smithy.

Once the skeletal remains are secured, Venya considers the initiate ready to step beyond simple dark spells. The recovered materials serve as a rite of passage, demonstrating that the novice can overcome mindless undead and withstand the bleak realities of their craft. In return, Venya imparts the rituals needed to bend an imp to the summoner's command, warning that despite the demon's diminutive stature, its cunning and fire will make it a dangerous ally.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: Greetings, child. I can see that you are still young in the ways of the adventurer, power still eluding your grasp. I can sense your eagerness to learn.
There is no strength in ignorance. Knowledge is our greatest power. Through its application, we can control the chaotic magics and beings of the void, bending them to our will.
I will show you how to bind a servant to your will, but first you must bring me three skulls of the rattlecage skeletons near the abandoned smithy.

clips.title: Progress
paras: Your power is little now, though I suspect already you sense the possibilities.
Even the dead might feel alive, with that power coursing through us.

clips.title: Completion
paras: Though you are still untested and young in your learning, you have proven that you possess sufficient ability to master the summoning and binding of an imp. Do not be deceived by an imp's size. Though it lacks physical strength, it possesses powers and a cleverness that will serve you well.
Attend me carefully, friend, for I will not repeat this lesson, and I will leave its mastery to you.
